parts.html: A professional designer can transform even the smallest bathroom. Here are the ideas they use to do it:

items: Compact fixtures: Smaller sinks, toilets, and showers leave more free space.
Wall-hung elements: Wall-hung toilets and sinks create a sense of more space and make cleaning easier.
Dark colors: Even dark shades, such as graphite, can make a space look larger.
Good lighting: Recessed lights, a backlit mirror, LED strips under the cabinets or around the perimeter of the ceiling.
Large mirrors: A full-wall mirror or large mirrored panels make a space feel noticeably bigger.
Built-in cabinets: Built-in cabinets fit neatly above the toilet, adding plenty of extra storage.
Gloss or matte: Glossy surfaces reflect light and make a room feel more spacious. But if you’d rather spend less time cleaning, choose a suitable matte finish.
Mosaic and tile: Small mosaics or tiles create interesting accents and draw attention away from the size of the room.
Minimalism: The less decor, the more open the room looks.

parts.html: An example of a successful solution: a light color palette, a large mirrored wall, wall-hung fixtures, glossy tiles, and built-in cabinets. This way, even the smallest bathroom feels spacious and comfortable.
